name: Kanrinin no Nozoki
source: Following an unexplained incident that led to the removal of the previous supervisor, you take over management duties at the Mango University women's dormitory. Alongside handling basic building upkeep, your underlying goal is to uncover the truth behind the past incident while investigating the private lives and secrets of the female tenants.
